brute.idea: Try subsets/orderings to maximize non-overlapping meetings.

optimal.idea: Sort by end time; greedily pick a meeting if it starts after the last picked one ends.

brute.idea: For each train, count overlaps with all others.

optimal.idea: Sort arrivals and departures; sweep both, +1 on arrival, -1 on departure, track peak.

better.idea: Sort by profit desc; for each job scan back from its deadline for a free slot.

optimal.idea: Sort by profit desc; place each job in the latest free slot using union-find.
Sort by burst time; shortest jobs first minimize average waiting time.
Add intervals ending before the new one, merge overlaps into it, then add the rest.

brute.idea: Sort by start; DP for the max set of compatible intervals (like weighted interval scheduling), removals = n - that.

optimal.idea: Sort by end; greedily keep non-overlapping intervals, count the rest as removals.
Sort children and cookies; give the smallest sufficient cookie to each child.
Sort by value/weight ratio; take greedily, splitting the last item as a fraction.
For canonical denominations, greedily take the largest coin <= remaining amount.
Track $5 and $10 bills; give change greedily, preferring a $10+$5 over three $5s.

brute.idea: DFS/DP trying every jump length from each index.

optimal.idea: Track the farthest reachable index; fail if the current index ever exceeds it.

brute.idea: DP: min jumps to each index from all reachable predecessors.

optimal.idea: BFS-like: track current jump boundary and farthest reach; increment jumps at each boundary.
Track min and max possible open count; '*' widens the range; valid if min hits 0 and max stays >=0.

brute.idea: Repeatedly sweep, bumping any child that violates a neighbor rule until stable.

optimal.idea: Two passes: left-to-right then right-to-left; take the max candy per child.
Simulate an LRU set/queue of capacity C; on a miss evict the least-recently-used and count the fault.
